name: tr_cmb
caption:
IF COLLIN WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐣 Torchic, the gamecock: South Carolina to pick 9
🔥 Ho-Oh, the comeback: mono couldn't stop him
🎨 Smeargle, the stat stuffer: 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks, 3 steals, a first in our history
🪲 Heracross, the giant slayer: playoff career-high 22 points as we beat Cleveland
🐆 Liepard, the thief: 4 steals at Milwaukee
🐻 Ursaring, the ace: our bruiser, 10.7 points a night through 9 games

Which one would you add? 👇

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.vo: If Collin Murray-Boyles was a trainer... this is his team.
beats.dlg: IF COLLIN WAS A TRAINER...|THIS IS HIS TEAM!

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.name: THE GAMECOCK
beats.vo: First up, the gamecock. A South Carolina Gamecock, and we took him ninth.

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.name: THE COMEBACK
beats.vo: The comeback. Mono knocked him out in college. He rose right back.

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.name: STAT STUFFER
beats.vo: The stat stuffer. Seventeen points, fifteen boards, three blocks, three steals. A first in our history.
beats.dlg: 17-15-3-3 IN ONE NIGHT.|FIRST IN OUR HISTORY!

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.name: GIANT SLAYER
beats.vo: The giant slayer. Twenty-two points as we beat Cleveland in the playoffs.
beats.dlg: THE GIANT SLAYER:|22 AS WE BEAT CLEVELAND!

beats.head: COLLIN'S TEAM
beats.name: THE THIEF
beats.vo: The thief. Four steals at Milwaukee this month.

beats.name: THE ACE
beats.vo: And the ace. Our bruiser. Ten point seven a night through nine games.
beats.dlg: THE ACE: OUR BRUISER.|10.7 A NIGHT, 9 GAMES IN!

facts.claim: Murray-Boyles played college basketball for the South Carolina Gamecocks; before the 2023-24 season he contracted mononucleosis and missed significant time, then became a top player upon returning; chosen ninth overall (#9, pick 9) by Toronto in 2025; January 11, 2026: 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks and 3 steals, the first player in Raptors history with those numbers; April 23, 2026: playoff career-high 22 points in a 126-104 win over Cleveland
